annotations.title: Recorded price changes of digital plans

description: Every recorded change of a digital plan's price, newest first: plan_id, verified_on (the day it changed), from and to (price and currency), source (person = confirmed against the official page in our review; catalog = the stored price list changed between two daily snapshots) and source_url. Recording started on tracking_since; nothing before it is known and nothing is back-filled, so an empty list means no change since tracking_since. An unchanged price renewed by the daily check is no change. Also rises: the price rises of the last 45 days (from -> to in one currency, period month | year, detected_on, source_url; status proposed = the official page shows the higher price and our list waits for confirmation, confirmed = our price list holds it; a yearly price is compared per month, two currencies never), and watch_coverage: how many priced plans a robot reads daily or weekly and which wait on the manual weekly list. Filter by plan (the id from /digital/plans).
name: digital_price_history
title: Recorded price changes of digital plans
